title: 第1446章 不算是稀有物品第1445章 攻下齐国的关键时期
slug: 饥荒年我囤货娇养了古代大将军
lines: 匀出一顿饭的时间应该可以！
“行，这样说好，记得你们两人都来我家吃饭！”
唉，不是只邀请叶苜苜吗？怎么战承胤也要去。
战承胤倒没有拒绝，看着叶苜苜是脸点头，“过几日，不太忙可以应约！”
范靖笑道：“那多谢大将军赏脸！”
忽然，叶苜苜问他，“有多少个人帮忙收集物资，我的意思是，你下面有多少个人拥有空间物品。”
说起这个，范靖一脸疲惫，“我下面除了几个死士当保镖，哪有人帮我收集物资，罗领导不太忙的时候倒是会帮忙！”
“可您也是知道的，他忙到睡觉的时间都没有，哪里会有多余的时间！”
“对了，刚才找您之前，罗领导说给一个空间戒指给小王，小王据说是有背景的红三代！”
“他做事倒很细致，可收集物资其实有一定危险性，我被跟踪过几回，甚至对方都想动手了！”
“我深刻吸取在飞机上被超控进入封闭箱的教训，感觉不对，立马带着保镖们闪身进入空间中！”
“你若是想发放空间物品，找人帮忙收集，倒是有一个人我建议，就是陈锋！”
唉，陈锋有一段时间没见着了。
帝都别墅里也不见踪影，不知道罗领导把他调配到哪里。
范靖解释：“他有战斗机，飞机驾照，各种汽车开得也非常溜，我去外地收取货物，都是他带着小队开车，开直升飞机陪同！”
原来如此，难怪陈锋这段时间不见人。
“你如果给一个空间戒指给他，然后开通他进空间的权限，那么减轻了我许多工作量，对于我后期在各个城池开通商贸有很大帮助！”
叶苜苜了然地点头，“好，我知道的，到时候我找陈锋聊聊！”
“行，他不会拒绝，空间戒指唉！”
“如果现代世界末日了，在戒指里存放足够的食物水源生活用品，能活得很久很久！”
“好，你先回去，我等会找他！”
范靖很开心，如果有陈锋的帮忙，会减轻他许多负担。
“那我走了，再见老板，战承胤！”
“再见！”
两人目送他离开，返回到空间里……叶苜苜坐下后，有小王陈锋帮忙囤积物资，人手还是不太够了。
也不知道浩毅，王小成他们几个现在在做什么。
叶苜苜想着，便问出来。
战承胤见她询问浩毅几人，说：“他们还在战国，自从有领主基地，把他们几人高兴坏了！”
“他们建议安置领主基地的地方，都符合防水倒灌，特大洪水……”
“战国已经安置了，十几个中型领主基地！”
“他们帮忙迁移百姓，有些不肯搬的也不强迫，会让工程队给他们建好坚固的房子，做好火炕！”
“五千人左右的村落，会放置一个微型基地，派几十个战家军驻守！”
“现在战国半数城池，都有领主基地！”
“战国京都两个合并的超级领主基地，一个大型领主基地，能住五百万人口！”
“现在已经四百万人口，每天不断有有百姓迁移住进京都！”
很好唉！
已经很久没有回到战国，不知道哪里会发生怎样的变化。
叶苜苜对战承胤说：“不然，给浩毅一枚空间戒指！”
“他和王小成雄壮他们，在战国深耕了大半年，对战国各个城池比我还要了解！”
“那座城池缺少什么，他们最是清楚不过！”

You should be able to spread out the time for a meal!
"Okay, as promised, remember that both of you come to my house for dinner!"
Alas, aren't we only inviting Ye MiClub? Zhan Chengyin wants to go no matter what.
Zhan Chengyin didn't refuse. He looked at Ye Mochu and nodded, "In a few days, if I'm not too busy, I can accept the appointment!"
Fan Jing smiled and said, "Thank you so much, General, for the compliment!"
Suddenly, Ye Clover asked him, "How many people are helping to collect supplies? I mean, how many people below you have space items."
Speaking of this, Fan Jing looked tired, "Except for a few dead soldiers serving as bodyguards, there is no one to help me collect supplies. Leader Luo will help me when he is not too busy!"
"But you also know that he is so busy that he doesn't even have time to sleep. How can there be any extra time!"
"By the way, before I came to you just now, Leader Luo said that he would give a space ring to Xiao Wang. Xiao Wang is said to be a third-generation red man with a background!"
"He is very meticulous in his work, but collecting supplies is actually dangerous. I have been followed several times, and the other party even wanted to take action!"
"I learned a lesson from being overridden and entering a closed box on a plane. It didn't feel right, so I immediately took my bodyguards and jumped into the space!"
"If you want to distribute space items and find someone to help collect them, there is one person I would suggest, and that is Chen Feng!"
Alas, I haven’t seen Chen Feng for a while.
There was no sign of him in the Imperial Villa, and he didn't know where Leader Luo had deployed him.
Fan Jing explained: "He has a fighter jet, an airplane driver's license, and he drives all kinds of cars very smoothly. When I go to pick up goods in other places, he leads a team to drive and a helicopter to accompany me!"
So that's the case, no wonder Chen Feng hasn't seen anyone during this period.
"If you give him a space ring and then grant him permission to enter the space, it will reduce a lot of my workload and will be of great help to me in opening up commerce in various cities in the future!"
Ye Clover nodded clearly, "Okay, I know. I'll talk to Chen Feng then!"
"Okay, he won't refuse, the space ring!"
"If the end of the world were to happen in modern times, if you store enough food, water, and daily necessities in your ring, you can live for a long, long time!"
"Okay, you go back first, I'll find him later!"
Fan Jing was very happy. With Chen Feng's help, a lot of his burden would be relieved.
"Then I'm leaving. See you boss, Zhan Chengyin!"
"Goodbye!"
The two of them watched him leave and return to the space... After Ye Clover sat down, Xiao Wang Chen Feng helped to stock up on supplies, but the manpower was still not enough.
I don’t know what Haoyi, Wang Xiaocheng and the others are doing now.
Ye Clover thought and asked.
Zhan Chengyin saw her asking about Haoyi and the others, and said, "They are still in the Warring States Period. Ever since there was a lord base, they have been very happy!"
"The place they proposed to place the Lord's base should be waterproof for backflow and severe flooding..."
"Warring States has already set up more than a dozen medium-sized lord bases!"
"They helped relocate the people, and even those who refused to move were not forced to do so. They asked the engineering team to build solid houses and fire pits for them!"
"In a village of about 5,000 people, a micro base will be placed and dozens of Zhan Family troops will be stationed there!"
"Now half of the cities in the Warring States Period have lord bases!"
"Two super lord bases merged in Kyoto during the Warring States Period. One large lord base can accommodate a population of five million!"
"It now has a population of four million, and people continue to move to Kyoto every day!"
Very good!
It’s been a long time since I’ve been back to the Warring States Period, and I don’t know what changes will happen there.
Ye Miglu said to Zhan Chengyin: "Otherwise, give Haoyi a space ring!"
"He and Wang Xiaocheng, Xiongzhuang, have been working in the Warring States Period for more than half a year, and they know all the cities in the Warring States Period better than I do!"
"They know best what is lacking in that city!"
